ExpectedFile.description: The version of a file the page showed, from `git.status` (or `git.hunks`).

diskBytesHash.description: `git.status.diskBytesHash` as shown, for a file without a text hash (binary, above the text limit).

diskHash.description: `git.status.diskHash` as shown: the text's hash, or null (deleted, binary, above the text limit).

RollbackExpect.description: What the page showed when the person chose Rollback.

deleteAdded.description: "Delete local copies of added files": new files go to the Trash (through the deletion policy).

paths.description: Files to bring back to HEAD, whole.

rolledBack.description: Paths brought back to HEAD (a new file: taken out of the index, kept on disk).

trashed.description: New files moved to the Trash.

summary: Brings files back to HEAD, whole, through the write policy and with a "before" copy of each; new                   files leave the index, and go to the Trash only with `deleteAdded`.
